text:
maria: Quick sync: PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823 updates Troubleshooting > Error reference — clarifies when clients will see 429 vs stream-timeout errors. Need review and a choice on conservative fallback wording.

tom: repro'd the scenario. short: client sends streaming request with long idle gap, infra returns stream interrupt (504) and connected client sees as timeout; if backpressure then 429. We need clear examples.

jen: @maria can you paste the current client snippet we want? I'll check SDK examples for parity.

maria: Added two snippets in the PR: one for high-level guidance, one for Node SDK:```js
const res = await client.generate({model:'redwood/text-1',prompt,stream:true,timeout:15000})
// on('error') handler: treat 429 as retryable with backoff, stream interrupts as non-idempotent
```

kai: nit: don't call stream interrupt 'non-idempotent' — it's about partial state. Suggest language: 'stream interruption may produce partial output; prefer resume or reissue only if prompt is idempotent.'

tom: :thumbsup: Agree with kai. Also we should include fallback policy YAML for Dedicated customers. Example:```yaml
fallback:
  when:
    - model_unavailable
    - rate_limit
  action: switch-to-compat-variant
  max_retries: 2
```

maria: good call. Is it OK to remove the old sentence that advised 'always retry 429 up to 5x'? That came from a pre-batching era.

jen: yes drop it. But add quick matrix: error -> recommended client behavior (429: retry with backoff up to 3, stream-timeout: inspect partial output, consider idempotence). I can draft.

maria: If we land that matrix, can we also add a crosslink to SDK guides and to runtime config page? Link: https://internal.redwood/docs/runtime/fallbacks

deploy-bot: Automated check: PR 4823 lint OK, links 1 broken (runtime/fallbacks -> 404).

tom: Broken link explains internal path rename. I'll open a tiny redirect PR against the docs site. ETA 2h.

kai: For the Node SDK snippet, add code to show `retry-headers` usage:```js
client.generate(..., {retryHeaders:{'x-retry-count':3}})
```

jen: I'll update PR with table + change log entry. Anyone object to landing this in the docs patch release tomorrow morning?

maria: No objections. Tom can you handle redirect? Kai can you add the Dedicated YAML? Jen will update PR text.

tom: On it. Will also ping eng-runtime for confirmation that 'switch-to-compat-variant' is the right action — @eng-runtime?

eng-runtime: Confirmed. We prefer `compat_variant` not `switch-to-compat-variant`. Small schema change.

maria: Thanks — will adjust YAML accordingly.

jen: Final checklist: update PR, fix link, add matrix table, add SDK snippet parity test, add changelog entry. I'll also add a docs-label and request reviewers.

maria: :shipit: aiming to merge tomorrow after small fixes. Thanks team.
